map.按深度 zigzag 写入，按行读出。: Write in a zigzag along rails, then read row by row.
map.栅栏密码：按「之」字形书写后按行读取。: Rail Fence cipher: write the text in a zigzag, then read it off row by row.
map.：把明文按之字形轨迹依次写入若干行，再按行顺序读出得到密文。: : Write the plaintext along a zigzag path into several rows, then read the rows in order to get the ciphertext.
map.：行数即密钥，行数越多置换越复杂。: : The number of rails is the key; more rails means a more complex permutation.
map.：按相同的之字形轨迹把密文填回各行，再按原顺序读出明文。: : Fill the ciphertext back into the rows along the same zigzag path, then read the plaintext in the original order.
map.：属置换密码，字母频率不变，可用频率分析破解。: : It is a transposition cipher; letter frequencies are preserved, so it can be broken by frequency analysis.
map.按之字形写入多行的置换密码，rail=3 常见。: A transposition cipher written zigzag across multiple rails; rail=3 is common.
map.讲清置换与替换的区别：栅栏只重排字母顺序而不改变字母本身，因此密文的字母频次与明: Clarify the difference between transposition and substitution: the rail fence only reorders letters without changing them, so the ciphertext's letter frequencies are identical to the plaintext—its most easily recognized weakness.
map.之字形写入后按行读出 → `WECRLTEERDSOEEAIVD`；解密按行回填: After zigzag writing, read row by row → `WECRLTEERDSOEEAIVD`; decrypt by filling back row by row.
map.栅栏密码密钥是什么？: What is the key of the rail fence cipher?
map.行数（rail 数），已知行数即可还原。: The number of rails; knowing it lets you recover the plaintext.
map.为什么 rail=2 时特别容易破？: Why is rail=2 especially easy to break?
map.因为 rails=2 时密文就是把明文的奇数位与偶数位分别取出后拼接，尝试两种切: Because with rails=2 the ciphertext is just the odd- and even-positioned characters taken separately and concatenated; trying the two split arrangements yields candidate plaintexts, effectively only 1 bit of key entropy. More rails slightly enlarge the key space, but it remains tiny—brute-forcing all rail values breaks it.
map.栅栏密码是一款IT 开发领域的在线工具。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代: The Rail Fence Cipher is an online tool in the IT development domain. Built for developers, runs entirely in the browser; your code never leaves the device.
